# meetings/

Output folder. One subfolder per meeting, named `YYYY-MM-DD-[slug]/`.

Inside each:

- `prep.md` — written before, by `meeting-prep`
- `notes.md` — the leader's own notes, if any
- `transcript.md` — the raw transcript, if a transcript tool is connected
- `actions.md` — written after, by `transcript-to-actions`
